scope: Read-only review of conversation gate, admission/cancellation, session load/create/rename/delete/connect and settings reload. SetupLifecycle reviewed for ConnectAsync/RefreshSessionsAsync plus actual LoadSettings call sites discovered during identity assignment check.
result: No further concrete blocking defect identified on the frozen reviewed scope after the two identity-rebinding corrections. Final global test gate is still required.

findings.problem: RefreshSessionsAsync could choose a fallback session from its bounded200-item list and reassign active _sessionId without loading its messages or memory. Turn/session lease prevented SelectionChanged from repairing that state.
findings.fix: Owner removed selection mutation from RefreshSessionsAsync and all eight call sites. Connect selects a candidate explicitly; only LoadSessionCore activates ID/messages/memory after successful read.
concreteCases: Active session missing from the bounded result
Refresh during Send, auto-title or rename

findings.fix: Owner permits restoring persisted LastSessionId only while _agent is null; connected memory keeps its identity.
findings.problem: LoadSettings was also called after setup/repair, not only construction, and could reload a persisted session hint over a connected conversation without rehydrating memory.

reviewedInvariants: One exclusive lease prevents simultaneous turn and session mutation.
Turn cancellation source/token exist from admission, including the durable-message preparation period.
Cancellation does not release a running owner; disposing an old lease cannot release a later owner.
Send and direct command retain the admitted session identity across awaits and persistence.
Session loading fetches messages and tracked state before resetting conversation memory.
Failed/cancelled reads release admission while keeping the previously loaded identity/memory.
Create/rename/delete/connect own their lease through awaits and release in finally.
Deleting current session clears identity/memory before an attempted next-session load can fail.
Deferred selection synchronization ignores an old target after actual session identity changes.
Only LoadSessionCore activation, explicit deletion invalidation and preconnection settings hint assign _sessionId.
limitations: Reviewer inspected tests but did not execute a concurrent build or test campaign.
Portable gate tests establish its concurrency/ownership contract; they do not instantiate MainWindow or prove native XAML behavior.
Normal installed-client success/error/cancellation/resume and visual selection smoke remain separate acceptance evidence.
